definitions.gloss: illustration; plate; figure; printed image in a publication
definitions.explanation: An illustration, photograph, diagram, or other visual image printed in a book, magazine, or other publication. Often refers specifically to full-page or high-quality reproductions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{図版|ずはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This book has many beautiful illustrations.

examples.japanese: {図版|ずはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巻末|かんまつ}→巻末：21973_kanmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめられている→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The descriptions of the plates are compiled at the end of the volume.

examples.japanese: {美術書|びじゅつしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧{図版|ずはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧{点以上|てんいじょう}⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The art book contains more than one hundred color plates of the artworks.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (figure, drawing) and ⟦{版|はん}→版：03698_han⟧ (printing plate, edition). Originally referred to the printing plate used to reproduce images, now refers to the printed image itself.

USAGE:
Common in publishing, art, and academic contexts. Art books, encyclopedias, and academic texts often list their {図版|ずはん} in a separate index. The word implies a certain level of quality or formality — casual photos in a magazine would not typically be called {図版|ずはん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧{図版|ずはん}: color plate
- {図版|ずはん}⟦{目録|もくろく}→目録：18979_mokuroku⟧: plate index; list of illustrations
- {図版|ずはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}する→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to include an illustration
- {図版|ずはん}⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧: plate description; caption
- {図版|ずはん}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of figures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{挿絵|さしえ}→挿絵：12818_sashie⟧: illustration (in a book) — specifically an artistic drawing inserted into the text, often in fiction
- ⟦{図表|ずひょう}→図表：04317_zuhyou⟧: charts and figures — refers to diagrams, graphs, and tables rather than photographic or artistic reproductions
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: photograph — a general term; {図版|ずはん} is more formal and can include non-photographic images
